description: Interpersonal conflict with one crew member escalated to the point of affecting daily operations. Root cause: lack of clear communication.
response: The Commander addressed it directly and behaviour improved. The Commander later reflected that being 'too transparent' had been a mistake — a stronger directive role was needed earlier.
lesson: Establish conflict resolution protocols before departure. The Commander should not share every concern publicly — some issues require private handling first. Define escalation steps: private conversation, formal intervention, Mission Support.
